waveHeightDerivation: Representative value for IMD sea state 'slight to moderate' (WMO scale: slight 0.5-1.25 m, moderate 1.25-2.5 m).
waveHeightMaxDerivation: Worst case for the same bulletin: sea 'becoming rough in thundershowers' (WMO rough = 2.5-4.0 m). Surfaced in the reasoning via escalation detection; verdict stays driven by the representative height plus alerts, consistent with IMD Warning NIL.
windDerivation: Midpoint of bulletin 15-20 knots = 27.8-37.0 km/h (1 kt = 1.852 km/h).
alertsBasis: Bulletin Warning NIL + Port Signal NIL; HIGH WAVE ALERT Nil (CWC Visakhapatnam fisherman warning); RSMC New Delhi coastal bulletin archive: North Andhra DAILY TWO 06-Sep-2026 — No Warning (verified 2026-09-07).

tide.derivation: Representative semi-diurnal prediction for Visakhapatnam standard port on 07 Sep 2026 (typical spring-neap range ~1.2-1.6 m on this coast). Exact heights/times vary with the lunar cycle — verify against INCOIS tide tables before operational use.

sources: mausam.imd.gov.in/visakhapatnam/mcdata/Fisherman_warning.pdf (HIGH WAVE ALERT: Nil; ocean-current alerts only for East Godavari/Guntur coasts, 03-05 Sep 2026)
